ModMetaData.name: Wil's Better Beds
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description:
Where a colonist sleeps now matters to them, and they do something about it. Beds are chosen by how happy they would make the person in them, a colonist who sleeps badly can ask someone for their room (or move to an empty one), couples look for a room together, and who sleeps nearby counts. You always have the last word.
Everything is measured in mood points, the game's own unit. A colonist is only pushed to change rooms when they have a sleep-related penalty; if nothing is wrong, they are content and left alone.
WHAT IT CHANGES - Bed choice: a bedless colonist takes the nicest free bed they can reach, not the nearest. A colonist with a sleep penalty moves to a free bed that clearly fixes it. - Royalty titles need a personal bedroom that meets their requirements. The Jealous, Greedy and Ascetic traits count as the game scores them. A room that is too cold or too hot for the sleeper counts against it, as the game's own cold and heat sleeping penalties do. - Within 35 tiles of a bed: relatives you dislike -2, disliked colonists -4, sleeping near an occupied prisoner bed -3, people of your ideoligion +2, people of your xenotype +2. Each is a real thought, and every number is adjustable. - Room negotiation: a colonist with a sleep penalty can spend recreation asking someone for their room. A d20 contest decides it (Social, or Melee to intimidate, plus opinion, title and time in the colony). Winners gain Social experience; both sides feel it in their mood. - Couples negotiate together: when both want a room, the better talker asks and a win moves both. When only one wants to move, they first talk their partner round, then the better talker asks. Couples with a sleep penalty are also moved into a free room of their own. - You decide: Set Owner locks a bed. Nobody negotiates for it, and its owner does not negotiate or move. - No bed: dozing in a chair instead of the floor, for a smaller penalty. Applies to guests and visitors too. - Assign rooms: a button on the Assign tab lists every room with beds, with hover highlights, double-click to jump, and per-room owner assignment.
WORKS WITH - Hospitality: your guests keep Hospitality's bed choice, rent and rules. A guest with no bed sleeps in a chair. - Spaceports and trade caravans: visitors who are not Hospitality guests used to sleep on the floor whatever they carried. They now rent a free guest bed when they can pay; those who cannot sleep in a chair. - Dubs Bad Hygiene: nobody is pulled into a conversation while using the toilet, shower or bath. - Interaction Bubbles: negotiations show as speech bubbles. Dubs Mint Menus, Vanilla Factions Expanded - Empire, Royalty, Ideology and Biotech are supported. - Other bed mods: bed choice runs last and defers to the game's own bed check, so whatever another mod forbids, this mod forbids too. Every patch is isolated; if one breaks, that one feature is skipped and logged and the rest keep working.
Prisoners, slaves, children and medical beds are left to vanilla. Everything is adjustable in the mod options, with a tooltip on every setting. Load after Harmony and any bed or room mods.
To report a bug, turn on "Log decisions" in the mod options, reproduce it, and press Ctrl+F12 for a log.
